info.name: SpotDraft V1 Contract APIs V2.1 Contract External Metadata API

params.name: contract_id
params.description: ID of the Contract. Should be of the form T-123 or H-123. T stands for Template contracts and H stands for Historical contracts.

items.docs:
Returns the external record metadata currently associated with the contract.

Pass the composite contract id in the path, for example `T-123` or `H-123`.

info.name: Create or Update Contract External Metadata

params.name: contract_id
params.description: ID of the Contract. Should be of the form T-123 or H-123. T stands for Template contracts and H stands for Historical contracts.

items.docs:
Creates or updates the external record metadata linked to the contract.

Use this to associate a SpotDraft contract with a CRM, ERP, or other external system record. Pass the composite contract id in the path, for example `T-123` or `H-123`.
